dict.string: Lintel reads what's playing in Apple Music and YouTube Music (in your browser) and controls playback from the notch.
macOS only shows Wi-Fi network names to apps with Location access. Lintel uses it to find your iPhone's hotspot when the Wi-Fi drops. It never reads your location.
